newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end on strong note after huge weekly gain.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end on strong note after huge weekly gain.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed on a strong note Friday, capping a week of huge gains built on upbeat corporate earnings.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended 44.95 points higher at 6,703.55, standing more than 310 points above last Friday's close as the blue-chip market clawed back from a four-week selloff of some 700 points.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a 14-9 on moderate volume of 471 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
